summary: Renames the order detail view from order_detail to show_order. The view now loads only the number and total_cents fields.

findings.title: URLconf still references the removed order_detail view
findings.problem: The change renames order_detail to show_order. orders/urls.py line 8 still references views.order_detail.
findings.consequence: Importing orders.urls raises AttributeError, so the root URLconf fails to load. Every request to the site then fails, including the order list.
findings.fix: Keep the order_detail name, or update orders/urls.py line 8 to use views.show_order.

findings.title: Changed detail view has no covering test
findings.problem: The detail view now uses a deferred-field queryset and has a new name. No test requests the detail route.
findings.consequence: No test caught the broken route registration. A later template change could also read a deferred field and add queries unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add a test that requests orders:detail as a logged-in user and checks the response.
